description: The Institute of Chartered  Accountants of  Sri Lanka -  SLAUS 315 - identifying  and assessing risks of material misstatement
reasoning: This gazette content involves the adoption and publication of a revised Sri Lanka Auditing Standard (SLAu S 315) by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka under the authority of the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. This constitutes a regulatory framework update and compliance requirement, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for regulatory matters and statutory instruments.
